entries.result: A new drug allows its users to project their consciousness through time, but it turns them into dangerous psychopaths.
A large humanoid creature was seen wandering around the outskirts of Town. Apparently, it is harmless.
An underground tunnel under the Town Hall connects the current Town to the original Town.
A severed limb/body part was found by the riverbanks/on the outskirts of Town. This happens from time to time, always in the same place, for years.
People dressed as clowns have been seen around Town, harassing those whom they meet. At first glance, they seem non-violent.
An influential citizen, regarded by all as a respectable and good-natured person, commands a crime network.
A cult has established on the outskirts of Town, and its leader wants to run for mayor.

A prominent citizen died in a car accident a few years ago. They replaced them with a look-alike who underwent several aesthetic interventions to look identical to the original, but a small scar on their forehead could not be hidden.
An unknown and abandoned building was found on the outskirts of Town. Its location is inaccurate because people reported seeing it at different sites.
The birds in the Town are actually robots that the government uses to keep an eye on everyone.
People who have been dead for decades have been seen across Town. At first glance, they seem friendly.
